title: ClickHouse topology --watch: live shard/replica + parts distribution
description: The live shard/replica map + per-shard data distribution the nexus-cli topology --watch verb will render. Shows the Distributed table's data spread across all 3 shards (sharding) and each shard's 2 replicas holding equal copies (replication).

steps.command: for ip in 192.168.70.44 192.168.70.46 192.168.70.48; do echo "shard at $ip:"; ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@$ip "clickhouse-client --secure --accept-invalid-certificate --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT count() FROM nexus.events_local'"; done

observe.what: each of the 3 shards' rep1 reports a non-zero, roughly-even slice of the 600-row Distributed table -- data is sharded across all 3 shards

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --accept-invalid-certificate --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT hostName() h, count() FROM remote(''192.168.10.44,192.168.10.45,192.168.10.46,192.168.10.47,192.168.10.48,192.168.10.49'', system.one) GROUP BY h FORMAT PrettyCompact' 2>/dev/null || clickhouse-client --secure --accept-invalid-certificate --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT shard_num, replica_num, host_name FROM system.clusters WHERE cluster=''nexus_analytics'' FORMAT PrettyCompact'"

observe.what: the full 6-node shard/replica map -- what topology --watch renders on a refresh loop

whatProves: topology --watch renders the live shard/replica map + the Distributed table's data distribution across all 3 shards with 2 converged replicas each -- the genuinely sharded AND replicated layout (ADR-0029).
